task.title: Deleting a robot account by using the Red Hat Quay API
task.shortdesc: To remove a robot account that you no longer need, you can delete it by using the Red Hat Quay API. You can delete robot accounts that belong to an organization or to your own user account.

ul.li: You have created an OAuth access token.

step.cmd: Enter the following command to delete a robot account for an organization by using the DELETE /api/v1/organization/{orgname}/robots/{robot_shortname} endpoint:

The CLI does not return information when deleting a robot account with the API. To confirm deletion, you can check the Red Hat Quay UI, or you can enter the following GET /api/v1/organization/{orgname}/robots command to see if details are returned for the robot account:
